newsitem.title: USA: U.S. DAP, ammonia prices flat in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DAP, ammonia prices flat in quiet trading.

text.p: U.S. cash diammonium phosphate and ammonia prices were flat Wednesday in uneventful dealings, cash sources said.
Markets were quiet but some sources noted a jump in the amount of pre-paid business in the Midwest. Dealers and farmers were paying for fertilzer now for application later this spring, they said.
Export markets remained quiet, dealers said.
Some market watchers were expecting an increase in activity in the barge fertilzer market because there were some producers who are short.
